info.name: Stack Overflow for Teams Answers API
Get Answers for a Team Question

params.name: team
params.description: The slug of the Stack Overflow for Teams workspace. If your team lives at stackoverflowteams.com/c/my-team, the slug is my-team.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the resource

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter to control which fields are returned

items.docs: Returns all answers to a specific question in a Stack Overflow for Teams workspace.
